title: Kimsuky malware disguised as a 2025 defense R&D document (analysis)
content_md:
Today we analyze malware attributed to North Korea's Kimsuky group that is disguised as "2025 defense-usable civilian-held technology.pdf," a document purportedly produced by the Defense Technology Promotion Institute. The lure is delivered as a Windows shortcut file.

File name: 2025 defense-usable civilian-held technology.pdf.lnk
Size: 70 MB
MD5: f0de28308a5d06f0b1758b2986fa576c
SHA-1: 60e797.. (truncated in source)
